text:
nidhi: Quick idea — run a 2-day ref-arch generalization workshop to make our Terraform templates cloud-agnostic and marketplace-ready. Goal: one canonical ref-stack repo, variant matrix, and CI smoke tests. Thoughts?

leo: Love it. Who's owning the variant matrix? We need mapping of modules -> provider variants.

sam: I can own CI smoke tests. Quick sketch of the test matrix:
```yaml
provider: [aws, gcp, azure]
arch: [ampere, x86]
mode: [dedicated, hosted]
```
Also will wire up terraform validate + plan in each variant.

taylor: We should include packaging constraints from each marketplace (images, license metadata). I'll pull the marketplace packaging doc and highlight gotchas.

emma: Agree. Also standardize module outputs so Redwood console can auto-discover metrics/traces. E.g. output "service_endpoint" and "observability_role_arn".

marketplace-bot: Reminder: marketplace packaging guide v2: https://internal.redwood.ai/marketplace/packaging-v2 (read-only link). Use `packaging-v2` tag for repo.

leo: Can we add a small adapter layer so customers can flip provider at deploy time without forking templates? That would reduce maintenance.

nidhi: Yes — two phases: 1) canonical ref-stack + adapter abstraction, 2) CI matrix + marketplace packaging. Deliverables: repo skeleton, variant matrix doc, CI pipelines, packaging checklist, and a short demo. 2-day working session next week?

sam: :thumbsup: Wed/Thu availability looks good for me.

taylor: Need legal present for packaging constraints. I'll invite Jordan from legal.

emma: Can we carve out 2 hours on day 1 for telemetry/output schema review?

nidhi: Perfect. I'll post a calendar invite (Wed 9am PT) and add a prep doc with current templates. Please add any pre-read links in the thread.

leo: I'll add the initial matrix doc to the repo: https://git.internal/redwood/ref-stack-matrix (stub).

nidhi: Thanks all — excited to make these templates truly portable and marketplace-friendly. :rocket:
